params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: task_uuid
params.description: UUID of a task whose company-private notes to list. Mutually exclusive with target_type/target_uuid.

items.docs:
ViewSet for managing notes.

Two note flavours share this viewset:

- **Company-CRM notes** — attached to a managed Company via the legacy
  ``target`` GenericForeignKey. MoR-only in practice (the queryset filters
  to companies the caller manages).
- **Task notes** — company-private annotations on a Task, linked through the
  ``TaskNote`` join (inversion of control; the note itself is context-free).
  Visible only to members of the note's owning company, never to another
  company on the same t
